title: PvP Consent
description: Lets players choose to consent to PvP.
body:
Do players on your server want PvP? But some of them don't? Well here you go! This gives players a way to "consent" to PvP

Commands:
- /pvpconsent [true/false]
> Sets your PvP consent status to True or False
> 
> When a user uses the command to switch consent status, it will broadcast in chat for everyone to know
- /pvpconsentlist
> Provides a list of the players and what status they have
- /pvpconsentcheck
> Tells the player what their consent status is

Combat Tag: If you hit or get hit by another player, you will be unable to switch to PvP disabled for 5 minutes.

You could also use this in singleplayer.. but who is there to fight you?
